deficits.evidence: People must walk in the road as there is no designated footway.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk on the right side of the road to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

deficits.evidence: The informal path is uneven and broken.
deficits.suggestion: Level and pave the informal path on the left side to remove trip hazards.

deficits.evidence: High pedestrian demand due to shops and residential buildings, but no designated crossing facility.
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing to provide a safe point for people to cross the road.

deficits.evidence: Urban road with no visible street lighting.
deficits.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety at night.

ratings.reason: The frames show pedestrians walking on the road surface with no visible pavement on the right, confirming the deficit.
The left side is obscured by trees and distance, making it impossible to verify the condition of the path.
There is no visible crossing facility on the road, and the suggestion is a standard measure for such a location.
The frames are taken during the day, so the presence or absence of street lighting cannot be determined.
